turns.patient_response: I’ve been having a lot of obsessive thoughts that I can’t seem to shut off, and they’re making it hard to get through my day. I end up doing certain things over and over to try to feel less anxious, but it’s taking a lot of time and really stressing me out. I’d like help understanding what’s going on and how to get it under control.
